description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ClaimDao related to ExpenseType operations within the OrangeHRM Claims module. It contains test methods for retrieving, deleting, and checking the usage of expense types, utilizing test fixtures and assertions.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTypeTest
classes.description: Test class for ClaimDao's ExpenseType functions, ensuring correct behavior for listing, retrieval by ID, deletion, and usage checking.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes ClaimDao instance and loads test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetExpenseTypeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of expense types with filter parameters, asserting expected results.

methods.name: testGetExpenseTypeById
methods.description: Tests fetching an expense type by ID and checks the name matches expected value.

methods.name: testDeleteExpenseType
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of expense types and verifies the number of deleted entries.

methods.name: testIsExpenseTypeUsed
methods.description: Checks if an expense type is used, asserting a boolean result.
